(3) Inside a kitchen, a stainless steel boiling pot is shown where several dumplings are being cooked in turbulent water; a metal mesh strainer is used to lift a batch of large, translucent-skinned dumplings out. (4) A series of extreme close-ups follow, showing a white plastic fork breaking open different dumplings to reveal fillings like green leeks with minced pork, yellow corn kernels with pork, and whole pink shrimp tucked inside the dough. (5) A white partitioned meal box is displayed, featuring a large serving of dumplings, a dipping sauce well, three bright red cherry tomatoes, and a side of green leafy vegetables and yellow kimchi. (6) A plastic spoon scoops into a clear bowl of yellow egg drop soup containing seaweed and red goji berries. (7) A person's hand holds a white paper cup under a beverage dispenser, filling it with a brownish liquid. (8) The camera pans across a clean, modern dining area with light wood counters and high-backed wicker chairs. (9) A staff member wearing a pink mask and a brown apron is seen from the side walking through the shop with a tray. (10) The final shots show the exterior of a neighboring shop named "蛋ㄕˋ幸福農場" and its brightly lit interior filled with refrigerated display cases.
